name: session_tree
description: Show the full session hierarchy for a given session — all ancestors up to the root and all descendants recursively, with each session's position in the tree and its owning agent ID. If no session_id is provided, uses the current session. Use this to understand where a session sits within a delegation chain, who spawned it, and what sub-sessions it has created.

session_id.description: ID of the session to inspect. Defaults to the current session.

include_stats.description: Include per-node statistics: message count and tool call count.
